description: The Chorus keeps the gate rota and the gate masks, and one of the masks has a lining that has been chafing Ossa Vurn for a month. She has mentioned it to everyone who has come through and nobody has ever picked it up. Pick it up.
name: A Needle and a Free Afternoon

objectives.desc: Restitch the gate mask lining at the north gate
emotes: {who} turns the mask over on their knee and works the quilted lining back onto the rim, one slow stitch at a time.
